newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan down at intraday low vs dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan down at intraday low vs dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at an intraday low of 8.2960 from Wednesday's 8.2956 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, due to profit-taking late in the session, traders said.
The yuan opened down at 8.2958 and hovered around 8.2954 for most of the session before hitting an intraday high of 8.2948, and then falling back to the intraday low.
Trading opened quietly but became active with most business done at 8.2954, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan's early stability led buyers to test resistance at 8.2950.
"But the yuan failed to stand firm," he said, adding that subsequent profit-taking pushed the currency to its intraday low.
A second dealer said the yuan's fall would not hurt strong pro-yuan sentiment and he expected the currency to bounce up slightly and move around 8.2955 on Friday.
The yuan closed up at an intraday high of 6.9401 from 7.0150 against 100 Japanese yen due to the yen's fall against the U.S. dollar in the world market.
The yuan ended slightly up at 1.0720 from 1.0722 against the Hong Kong dollar.
